$Comment: What a player sees and hears the moment an achievement is earned.
This is the library's own neutral default. A mod that ships a file with this same name in its
own pack replaces it, and a server owner can do the same from the owner layer.
The picture beside the words is the achievement's own, decided when the catalogue loaded, so
there is nothing to name here per achievement; an achievement with no picture gets a notice
The moment carries 'achievement' (its id), 'title' (its name in the reader's language),
'points' (what it is worth), 'awaiting_claim' (true when a reward still waits to be
collected) and anything the mod that catalogued it attached under its own names. 'player' is
always the name of who earned it.
Add a Broadcast group to tell the whole server; a line whose Key is a KeyArg reads its key
from one of the moment's own values, which is how a mod announces some achievements with
their own words and stays quiet about the rest.
